heading.line2: All four jobs for one restaurant.

work.intro: These are in-house examples, made for a bistro that doesn’t exist. Real client work takes their place once clients say we can show it.

website.title: Website
website.claim: For the person outside your door, checking the menu.
website.detail: Menu, hours, directions and booking, each one tap from the top and quick to load on two bars of signal. No PDF menus.

adCreatives.title: Ad creatives
adCreatives.claim: Clear enough to read at scrolling speed.
adCreatives.detail: One offer per ad and only a few words, sized for feeds and stories and made to look like your place.

socialMedia.title: Social media
socialMedia.claim: Something worth posting, even in a week when nothing’s new.
socialMedia.detail: We plan the week’s posts in your voice, from the specials board to the Mondays you’re closed, and aim them at people nearby.

seo.title: SEO
seo.claim: Right on Google, down to the holiday hours.
seo.detail: We keep your listing accurate and your reviews answered, and write the site around what people nearby actually search for.

heading.why: Short and sure of itself, it frames the mockups as finished outcomes, and the grey line quietly shows the four jobs working for a single place, which is the system idea again without saying it.

picker.heading: What’s slipping right now?
picker.intro: Tap the one that sounds like you. We’ll show you what we’d do and fill in the form below.

steps.first: We open your site on a phone, the way a hungry stranger would, and note everything that gets in the way.
steps.then: We build a new one around what people come for: the menu, the hours, directions and a way to book.
steps.everyWeek: When your menu or hours change, we change the site to match.

steps.first: We fix your Google listing: the hours, the photos, the menu link and the category you’re filed under.
steps.then: We make the site quick to load and write it around what people nearby type, like “brunch near me”.
steps.everyWeek: We answer new reviews and keep the listing right, holiday hours and photos included.

steps.first: We work out what’s worth posting about your place, from the dishes to the people who cook them.
steps.then: We plan the posts ahead and write them in your voice, so they sound like you and not like a chain.
steps.everyWeek: We post for people nearby and tie each post to what’s on, like a new special or a day you’re closed.

steps.first: We pick the one thing each ad should sell, like a set lunch or a night you want busier.
steps.then: We make it in the sizes it needs, built for a phone and readable before the thumb moves on.
steps.everyWeek: We make new ads for what’s on that week, so you’re not stuck with one tired ad for months.

steps.first: We look at your website, Google listing, posts and ads together, and start where it’s worst.
steps.then: We fix that first, then bring the other three into line so they all say the same thing.
steps.everyWeek: We keep all four going: posts go out, new ads get made, reviews get answered, the site stays right.
